profile.ja: 蟲遁の術を使う対魔忍。特殊なフェロモンを発することによって虫を自由に操り、戦闘から斥候まで幅広い任務に使役する。魔界に住む魔蟲には効果が薄いが、捕獲し飼育を続ける事で一部使役する事に成功している。虫に関する豊富な知識を持ち、虫を原料とした毒や薬を作る事にも長けていて、危険な蟲も多数飼育しているため、街中からは離れた場所に居を構えているらしい。体術においても並の魔族には負けない程度の腕前を持つが、蟲を扱うというその忍法は、同じ対魔忍からも恐れられることが多く、彼女と組んだ若手は目の前で魔蟲が敵を蹂躙する様を見てトラウマになる事もある。しかし彼女はその力に自信と誇りを持っているので堂々と振る舞っている。また、そんな姿を見て喜ぶサディスティックな性質と、享楽主義的な面もあり男の噂は絶えないものの、彼女の性癖についていける男がいないのか、決まった相手はいない様子。
profile.en: Soma Narumi is a Taimanin who employs the insect-escape technique. By emitting a special pheromone, she freely commands insects, using them for a wide range of tasks from combat to scouting. While the effect is weak on demon insects native to the Demon Realm, she has managed to capture and domesticate some, successfully commanding a few. She possesses extensive knowledge of insects and excels at creating poisons and medicines from them; because she keeps many dangerous insects, she lives in a secluded area away from the city. In hand-to-hand combat she can hold her own against average demons, but her insect-based ninjutsu often frightens fellow Taimanin, and junior partners who team up with her sometimes develop trauma after witnessing demon insects tearing enemies apart. Nevertheless, she is confident and proud of her abilities, carrying herself with poise. Her sadistic enjoyment of such scenes and hedonistic streak keep rumors about her circulating among men, yet no one seems able to satisfy her particular tastes, and she appears to have no steady partner.

text.ja: 相馬成美よ……へぇ、あなたが噂の……なるほどねぇ？　少しは私のことを、愉しませてくれると嬉しいんだけど……期待してるわよ？
text.en: I'm Soma Narumi... Huh, you're the one they've been talking about? Well, I suppose it's nice to meet you. I hope you can entertain me a bit, though - I'm looking forward to it.

text.ja: なにをしてるのかって？　見ればわかるでしょう……可愛い虫たちの世話をしてるのよ。ほら、あなたもやってみなさい、遠慮することないわ
text.en: What do you think I'm doing? It's obvious, isn't it? I'm taking care of my cute little insects. Go ahead and try it yourself, don't be shy.

text.ja: 蟲遁の術は、フェロモンで虫たちを操るのよ。どんな虫も、私の意のまま……あなたも、そんな虫の一匹にしてあげようかしら？
text.en: The insect escape technique uses pheromones to control insects. Any insect will do my bidding... and maybe I'll make you one of them, too.

text.ja: なに、私の家に興味があるの？　まぁ構わないけど……遠いわよ。飼っている虫も多いから、中心部からは離れた場所にあるのよ
text.en: You're interested in my home? Well, it's not like I mind, but... it's pretty far out. I have a lot of insects to take care of, so I live in a secluded area.

text.ja: そろそろ私との初任務ねぇ……ええ、愉しみよ。私と組んだ子はだいたい、蟲遁の術を見てトラウマになるのよね……あぁ、愉しみだわ♪
text.en: It's time for our first mission together, isn't it? Ah, I'm looking forward to it. Most of the girls who team up with me end up with trauma after seeing my insect technique... but that's just part of the fun, isn't it?

text.ja: ……つまらないわね、あなたの反応。素直に感心して、扱い方まで聞いてくるなんて……気に入らないから、次の任務も付き合ってあげるわ
text.en: Your reaction is pretty disappointing. I was expecting you to be more impressed... and ask me how to use the technique, too. But since you're not, I suppose I'll just have to tolerate you on our next mission.

text.ja: ただ操るだけじゃなく、飼って世話をしてあげることで、より操りやすくなるのよ……あなたも飼えば、もっと言うことを聞くようになるかしら？
text.en: It's not just about controlling them - taking care of them and raising them makes them even easier to control. Maybe if you tried raising some, they'd listen to you better, too?

text.ja: ふふっ、本当に飽きないわね、あなた……ええ、いい玩具が見つかって嬉しいわ♪　もっと愉しませてくれたら、またご褒美をあげるわね……
text.en: Hehe, you really are entertaining... I'm glad I found a toy like you. If you can keep me entertained, I might just give you a reward... or two.
